findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_job_applications, create_job_application, list_career_entries, update_job_application_note, search_contacts, get_contact, add_contact_interaction, get_career_compass, generate_career_compass · Private data: get_job_fit_evidence, add_career_entry, get_career_journal_prompts, list_experiences, add_job_application_note, update_job_application_note, search_contacts, get_contact, update_contact_status, add_contact_interaction, save_career_compass · Public sink: add_job_application_note, update_job_application_note, add_contact_interaction · Destructive: update_job_application_status, toggle_job_application_interest, get_job_fit_evidence, delete_career_entry, delete_job_application_note, search_contacts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_job_applications, create_job_application, list_career_entries, update_job_application_note, search_contacts, get_contact, add_contact_interaction, get_career_compass, generate_career_compass · Private data: get_job_fit_evidence, add_career_entry, get_career_journal_prompts, list_experiences, add_job_application_note, update_job_application_note, search_contacts, get_contact, update_contact_status, add_contact_interaction, save_career_compass · Public sink: add_job_application_note, update_job_application_note, add_contact_interaction · Destructive: update_job_application_status, toggle_job_application_interest, get_job_fit_evidence, delete_career_entry, delete_job_application_note, search_contacts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
